violations.description: Ensures <meta http-equiv="refresh"> is not used for delayed refresh
violations.help: Delayed refresh under 20 hours must not be used
violations.failure_summary:
Fix any of the following:
  <meta> tag forces timed refresh of page (less than 20 hours)

ai_fix.plain_english_explanation: The element flagged for rule 'meta-refresh' violates WCAG guidelines (Delayed refresh under 20 hours must not be used). It prevents assistive technology from correctly interpreting page structure.
ai_fix.why_it_matters: Users relying on screen readers or keyboard navigation encounter barriers when interacting with this component.
remediation_steps: Apply accessible markup attributes and ensure proper semantic HTML nesting.
